title: myn-blob — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins protocol::encode_new_note_blob_raw + protocol::encode_update_blob_raw + protocol::decode_note byte mapping for the MY01 per-note blob format. Four case kinds: 'encrypt' (encoder byte output across plaintext sizes), 'encrypt_update' (§6.3 note-update path — header_prefix spliced verbatim, only content_nonce + ciphertext change), 'decrypt_ok' (round-trip success), 'decrypt_aead_fail' (non-distinguishing AEAD-stage rejection per spec §6.4). Content-type is HARDCODED to 'text/markdown' in v0.1 (bound into aad_note_content_encrypt) — no per-vector variation parameter. Spec contract: docs/spec/protocol.md §9.2 + §6.3 + §6.4 + §6.5.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'myn-blob/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: encrypt — pin the encoder's byte output across plaintext sizes

input_plaintext_hex.description: Plaintext bytes (hex). Variable length up to MAX_PLAINTEXT_LEN (16 MiB) — vectors cover 10 B / 1 KB / 100 KB representative sizes.

expected_myn_blob_hex.description: Full MY01 blob (header_prefix + content_nonce + ciphertext_len_be32 + ciphertext + CTX tag). Length = 76 + plaintext.len() + 32 bytes.

oneOf.title: encrypt_update — pin the §6.3 note-update encoder (header_prefix spliced verbatim)

input_source_blob_hex.description: The original MY01 blob being updated. A port decodes it (decode_note) to recover the DecryptedNote handle, then re-encodes content via encode_update_blob_raw.

input_new_content_nonce_hex.description: Fresh 24-byte content_nonce for the re-encryption. MUST differ from the source blob's content_nonce — nonce reuse under a fixed item_key is catastrophic (spec §6.3).

input_new_plaintext_hex.description: New plaintext bytes (hex). May be larger or smaller than the source's plaintext; the update encoder tracks the new ciphertext_len.

expected_myn_blob_hex.description: Full updated MY01 blob. Bytes [0..112] (header_prefix) MUST equal the source blob's bytes [0..112] verbatim; only content_nonce + ciphertext_len + ciphertext change. Length = 76 + new_plaintext.len() + 32 bytes.

informational_header_prefix_preserved.description: Asserts the §3.3 invariant: the 112-byte header_prefix (magic, version, reserved, items_key_id, item_key_nonce, enc_item_key_len, enc_item_key) is spliced verbatim from the source — enc_item_key is never re-wrapped across an update, which is what lets password rotation leave every .myn file untouched.

oneOf.title: decrypt_ok — pin the decoder's successful round-trip

expected_plaintext_hex.description: Recovered plaintext bytes (hex). The decode_note caller compares its DecryptedNote.plaintext() output byte-equal.

oneOf.title: decrypt_aead_fail — pin the non-distinguishing AEAD-stage failure surface

expected_kind.description: Rust reference returns Err(DecryptError::CannotDecrypt) — single non-distinguishing variant per spec §6.4. Ports MUST NOT distinguish wrong-key / wrong-AAD / tampered-ciphertext / tampered-tag beyond a single 'cannot decrypt' outcome at the caller-visible surface.
